resources.string: Generates 128 MiB of fixed test data in the app private folder, builds a throwaway repository for each of 5 levels (OFF / L1 / L3 / L6 / L19), and writes a snapshot through exactly the same tar and rustic path as a real backup. Needs about 320 MiB of free space; the temporary repository and test data are deleted when finished, and your real repository is never touched.

Benchmarking is CPU heavy. Keep the screen on and let the device stay cool; do not run a backup or browse files while measuring. Charging during the test causes heat and throttling, which skews the numbers low.

Speed includes fixed overhead, so low levels are faster in a real backup; remote backups are also limited by network bandwidth. Time× and Size× are relative to OFF (1.000); single-run results vary by about ±15%, and levels whose time falls within that noise are picked by the smallest volume.
